capabilities.title: Summary, changes, evidence, risks, and blockers completion contract
Local-only protected runtime status and control-plane routes
Replayable monotonic SSE runtime event service
capabilities.sourceEvidence: RUNTIME_API.md SSE events and replay sequence
capabilities.reason: Nexus already uses its in-app event bus and durable run artifacts. A second external runtime event service would duplicate the active control plane without adding a required operator capability.

capabilities.title: Standalone Rust terminal UI and coding-agent runtime
capabilities.reason: Nexus assimilates the governance and continuity behavior inside its existing Next.js runtime instead of shipping a second user-facing coding-agent product.

capabilities.title: Automatic runtime updater and installer
capabilities.reason: Nexus does not silently install or update external runtimes. Dependency and runtime changes remain explicit operator actions.

capabilities.title: Hosted relay or broad unauthenticated network binding
capabilities.sourceEvidence: RUNTIME_API.md security boundary and mobile/LAN mode
capabilities.reason: Nexus remains local/private-network first with authenticated routes and does not add a hosted relay or unauthenticated broad bind.
